cohort: 221 infants born between 24 and 42 weeks gestation
finding: This study established gestational age-specific reference ranges for Hep(CB) in preterm infants and found that iron stores, gestational age, and mode of delivery were associated with Hep(CB).
mod_finding: Infants delivered by elective caesarean section had lower Hep(CB) than those born after spontaneous vaginal delivery or secondary caesarean section.
birth_weight: Infants with a standard deviation score for birth weight (SDSBW) <-2 had lower Hep(CB) compared to infants with SDSBW ≥-2
